name: Grade 7 IT: mBot Parts and mBlock
description: mBot hardware, software, robot parts, sensors, mBlock workspace, scripts, blocks, and uploading programs.

words.definition: A small educational robot used to learn robotics and programming.
words.example: The mBot followed the program from mBlock.

words.definition: The physical parts of a robot or computer.
Programs that tell hardware what to do.
words.example: mBlock is software for programming the robot.

words.definition: The frame or body that holds robot parts together.
words.example: The wheels connect to the chassis.

words.definition: A part that creates movement by turning or spinning.
A part that detects information from the environment.
A small light that can be controlled by a program.
words.example: The LED showed the robot was ready.

words.definition: A robot part that makes sound.
The board that runs the robot program and controls parts.
words.example: The controller sent commands to the motors.

words.definition: A block-based coding environment used with mBot.
words.example: Students built their first script in mBlock.

words.definition: The area in software where tools and code are organized.
words.example: The mBlock workspace includes blocks and a scripts area.

words.definition: A character or object in a block-based project.
words.example: The sprite moved on the stage.

words.definition: A coding instruction that can be snapped into a program.
words.example: The movement block made the robot go forward.

words.definition: A group of connected blocks that run together.
To send a program from the computer to the robot.
words.example: The group uploaded the script to the mBot.

words.definition: The screen and controls used to work with software.
A group of parts that work together.
words.example: The robot is a system of sensors, motors, code, and power.

words.definition: The job or purpose of a part.
